The Honda Pilot family

4 generations and variants in the Index, 2003–present. Oldest first; every card opens the full page, with its own versions, figures and story.

  1. 2003–2008

    Honda Pilot (first generation)

    The first Pilot, 2003–2008: Honda's first 8-seat SUV, a unibody with a V6 and 4-wheel drive, built in Canada and then Alabama.

    240 hp7.6 sec 0-60806,536 built
  2. 2009–2015

    Honda Pilot (second generation)

    The second Pilot, 2009–2015: bigger and deliberately boxy, with a 250-hp V6, built in Alabama.

    250 hp7.9 sec 0-60789,116 built
  3. 2016–2022

    Honda Pilot (third generation)

    The third Pilot, 2016–2022: sleeker, lighter and much quicker, with a 280-hp V6, torque-vectoring all-wheel drive and, at the top, a 9-speed automatic.

    280 hp6.0 sec 0-60909,116 built
    3.5-liter V6, 9-speed automatic · 3.5-liter V6, 6-speed automatic
  4. 2023–present

    Honda Pilot (fourth generation)

    The fourth Pilot, 2023 on: the biggest Honda SUV yet, with a new 285-hp V6, a 10-speed automatic, an off-road TrailSport and a second-row middle seat that stows under the cargo floor.

    285 hp6.9 sec 0-60478,144 built
